material_finding.canonical_hypothesis: Mechanism states that after orthogonalization the surviving plan-unique component is norm-matched to a frozen reference norm before one-shot injection.
material_finding.frozen_prereg_contract: Active intervention is raw r_unique and explicitly must NOT be rescaled/amplified to ||r_plan||; instead every non-NO_PATCH specificity control is rescaled to the TARGET ||r_unique||. Alpha grid provides bounded scale sensitivity.
material_finding.minimal_repair: Prospectively reconcile canonical hypothesis authority to the already-frozen raw-r_unique contract (preferred because it preserves the independently audited prereg bytes), or deliberately revise prereg/contract to an explicit reference-norm intervention and regenerate/review all dependent hashes. Do not execute science until one normalization rule is authoritative everywhere.
material_finding.scope_repair: Define 'plan-unique' operationally as 'orthogonal to the frozen selected nuisance span' rather than a globally identified plan-only latent factor. material_finding.why_material: These are different interventions. A positive result would be mechanistically ambiguous about which canonical hypothesis was actually tested, and implementation could legitimately follow either authority unless reconciled before engineering/Experiment registration.

nonblocking_notes: Zero-unique retention is a conservative fail-closed denominator rule and is compatible with a cohort-level kill condition for too many negligible/unconstructible families.
Layer/alpha narrowing is a development-informed prospective design choice, not independent evidence; use only fresh successor outcomes and preserve the untouched confirmation barrier.
